title: Settings
subtitle: Operator preferences for this terminal
uiLanguageHint: Menus, labels, and pages across the app.
replyLanguageHint: The language engrams and PYRI respond in during chat and inquiries.
replyAuto: Automatic — match whatever language I write in
rtlNote: Right-to-left layout is applied for Arabic.
ggufBody: Use your own .gguf model with ENGRAM's managed local engine. The desktop app copies the model into protected app storage, checks it before launch, and keeps it available across updates.
ggufDesktopOnly: Custom GGUF import runs in the ENGRAM desktop app. The web app can connect to a local server, but a browser cannot start or manage the desktop engine.
localServerBody: Check whether this browser can reach a desktop-hosted ENGRAM server. The check only requests the public health endpoint and never sends credentials or local file paths.
localServerNotConfiguredHint: Enter the address shown by the desktop app, then check the connection.
localServerCheckingHint: Waiting for the local server to respond.
localServerReachableHint: The local server responded. You can use this browser with the desktop engine.
localServerUnavailableHint: Start the desktop app or local server, verify the address, then try again.
localServerInvalid: Use an http:// or https:// origin without a path, query, fragment, username, or password.

localModelFailure.automaticRepair: Automatic repair is available on this platform. Retry Built-in after the repair completes.
localModelFailure.fallbackMessage: The local model could not start.

missingLinuxDependencies.title: Built-in model needs Linux libraries
missingLinuxDependencies.message: The built-in local model is missing Linux runtime libraries: {{libraries}}.
missingLinuxDependencies.guidance: Install the missing runtime packages for your distribution, or use a local server or online provider instead.
missingLinuxDependencies.recovery: Automatic repair is not available on Linux. Select Local server or Online, then choose Save & Restart.

missingWindowsDlls.title: Built-in model runtime is incomplete
missingWindowsDlls.message: The installed llama.cpp runtime is missing files: {{libraries}}.
missingWindowsDlls.guidance: Reinstall or update ENGRAM, or use a local server or online provider instead.
missingWindowsDlls.recovery: Automatic repair is not available for this installation. Select Local server or Online, then choose Save & Restart.

generic.title: Built-in model could not start
generic.message: The local model could not start: {{details}}
generic.guidance: The built-in local model is unavailable, but the rest of ENGRAM can continue with another provider.
generic.recovery: Select Local server or Online, then choose Save & Restart. You can retry Built-in after fixing the runtime.
